featured_reviews.name: shravani karale
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a really wonderful experience with  Keen Explorer. Everything throughout the trip was managed smoothly and thoughtfully, which made the journey very comfortable and enjoyable for us. A special thanks to tour manager Kedar, who was always approachable, helpful, and patient with everyone - more like a family member.  His coordination and caring nature truly made a difference during the trip.

The entire experience felt warm and well planned, and we returned with many happy memories. Grateful to Kedar for making the trip so pleasant. Would definitely recommend  Keen Explorer to anyone looking for a well-managed and memorable tour experience

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing honeymoon experience in Bali, all thanks to Keen Explorer for arranging everything so beautifully. From hotel bookings and airport transfers to sightseeing and day-wise planning, everything was perfectly managed and hassle-free.
A special thanks to Kedar and Swati for their constant support, quick responses, and thoughtful coordination throughout the trip. They made sure our journey was smooth, comfortable, and truly memorable.
The itinerary was well planned with a perfect balance of relaxation and exploration. We genuinely enjoyed every moment of our Bali honeymoon and would highly recommend Keen Explorer to anyone planning an international vacation or honeymoon trip. Thank you once again, Kedar and Swati, for creating such beautiful memories for us!

featured_reviews.name: Uwe Birkenhauer
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you very much Keen Explorer for the perfect organisation of our 10 day trip to Delhi, Agra, Jaipur and Mumbai. It was an amazing experience!! The trip was perfectly tailored to our wishes, changes and additions were always possible, still the price for the package was more than appropriate. It was our first time in India and thanks to Keen Explorer‘s expertise and foresight, everything went smoothly, we felt very well taken care of! So we could enjoy every single moment of our tour. We‘ll definitely come back for the South of India and looking forward to doing this with Keen Explorer again!

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Borgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Huge shoutout to Kedar for planning our first-ever international trip! My wife and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Since this was our first time traveling outside of India, we wanted everything to be perfect, and Kedar delivered exactly that.
He planned the trip according to our needs and wants, suggested a lot of things and made sure we had stress free experience.
The planning was flawless. The attention to detail, from the transfers to the daily arrangements was truly impressive. If you are looking for flawless planning and execution, I highly recommend him.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Keyur Pramanick
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you, Kedar & Keen Explorer Tours and Travels, for planning such a beautiful and memorable honeymoon trip to Bali for us. Every aspect of the journey was thoughtfully organized — from hotel arrangements and sightseeing to smooth travel coordination — making our experience completely stress-free and enjoyable.

Bali became even more special because of your excellent planning, prompt support, and attention to every little detail. We could truly relax and create lifelong memories without worrying about arrangements.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for making our honeymoon so wonderful and unforgettable. We highly recommend Kedar & Keen Explorer Tours and Travels to anyone looking for a well-planned and hassle-free travel experience. Looking forward to planning many more trips with you in the future!

featured_reviews.name: Meena Hariharan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kedar from Keen Explorer Tour organised and managed our Bhutan travel  efficiently. We had the group from Mumbai and Bengaluru a very good mix of traveller's. The vehicle, hotels and food arrangements was good. Bhutan is a beautiful place and brought us close to nature with it's  scenic beauty and greenery around.  The Guides were very well informed and took us through the  history and the strong heritage of Bhutan 🇧🇹
I wish Kedar and his team all the very best and give all his travelers a wonderful and memorable experience.

featured_reviews.name: Amar Kalbag
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wonderful Uttar Pradesh Tour with Keen Explorer

Our recent Uttar Pradesh tour with Keen Explorer, led by Mr. Kedar Ubhaykar, was excellent. The entire journey—from Varanasi to Prayagraj, Ayodhya, and Lucknow—was smooth, well-planned, and meaningful.

Kedar’s knowledge, patience, and professionalism made the trip truly enriching. His clear explanations, friendly nature, and prompt support ensured we were comfortable throughout.

Thanks to his dedication and personal attention, our tour became memorable and hassle-free. We would happily travel with Keen Explorer again and highly recommend them for Uttar Pradesh tours.

featured_reviews.name: Annmol Hattikudur

Everything was well organized, and we had a smooth and memorable holiday. Would definitely recommend Keen Explorer for travel planning and bookings.

The team was professional, responsive, and always ready to help with any queries. Their guidance made the trip smooth and stress free, and we truly enjoyed attractions like Sentosa Island, Universal Studios, Gardens by the Bay, and the city tour.
Overall, it was a memorable and hassle-free trip. I highly recommend this travel agency to anyone planning a Singapore vacation. Great service and excellent coordination throughout!

featured_reviews.name: vikash padhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Traveling with a tours and travels company was a memorable and enriching experience. From the moment the journey began, everything was well-organized and hassle-free. The tour operators took care of transportation, accommodation, and sightseeing, allowing us to relax and enjoy the trip without worrying about planning or logistics.

The itinerary was thoughtfully designed, covering popular attractions as well as local cultural spots. Our tour guide was knowledgeable and friendly, sharing interesting facts and stories about each destination. This made the journey both informative and enjoyable. Traveling in a group also gave us the opportunity to meet new people and share experiences, which added to the fun.

The accommodation and travel arrangements were comfortable and punctual, ensuring a smooth journey throughout. Overall, the experience with tours and travels was safe, convenient, and enjoyable. It helped us make beautiful memories and truly appreciate the joy of exploring new places.

featured_reviews.name: Harsha Narang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Service by Prathmesh Travels
exceeded our expectations in every way.

Due to my health conditions, initially I didn't join my husband for Char Dham Yatra of Uttrakhand viz. Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath. However, because of efforts and professional confidence given by Mr. Santosh Pandey (owner of Prathmesh Travels) I joined Yatra after one day of commencement of Yatra with my husband. Initially, I didn't had any bookings, however, Mr. Santosh Pandey took all pains and efforts and did my registration of Char Dham Yatra, Helicopter registration of Kedarnath, etc. at the very last moment and because of his professional approach and efforts, I could complete Yatra with my husband in a very comfortable and safe way alongwith 10 other group members.

The staff of Prathmesh Travels were knowledgeable, friendly, and made the experience even more enjoyable and safe. The food provided during Yatra was very good and hygienic. The company's commitment to customer satisfaction was evident throughout our trip. We'd highly recommend them to anyone looking for a stress-free, memorable and safe Char Dham Yatra.

featured_reviews.name: Sadhna Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text: Tour with Prathamesh Travels has been a very beautiful and memorable experience. The entire travel was very comfortable and the tour manager was very courteous and helpful. We could enjoy all the destinations we traveled to. The stay was very comfortable be it in the tent or hotel. Informative and friendly tour manager. I would definitely like to travel with Prathamesh Travels again. 😀

featured_reviews.name: Manish Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently traveled to the Maha Kumbh Mela, Varanasi Kashi Vishwanath Temple, and Ram Mandir in Ayodhya with Prathmesh Travels, and the experience was outstanding. The entire trip was meticulously planned, and our VIP passes were pre-booked, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free darshan at every destination. Despite the heavy traffic conditions, the arrangements were seamless.

One of the best parts of the journey was the comfortable and well-managed tent stays, which added to the spiritual experience. A special thanks to Mr. Santosh Pande, who personally traveled with us and ensured everything was perfectly organized. Highly recommend Prathmesh Travels for a well-planned, comfortable, and stress-free pilgrimage!

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Soni
featured_reviews.review_text: We had an unforgettable holiday, thanks to the exceptional planning and arrangements by Prathamesh Travels. Mr. Suhas was always available to answer our questions, address concerns, and make adjustments to our itinerary when needed. His level of communication and responsiveness was outstanding, ensuring that we felt supported and cared for throughout the trip.

I highly recommend Pick Trip, organized by Suhas Chopde, to anyone planning a visit to Turkey. Since we were traveling with kids, we were a bit concerned about comfort and logistics, but Glamour Tours handled everything so smoothly that the trip turned out to be completely stress-free.

The itinerary was very well planned, covering all the major attractions while still allowing enough time to relax. The pace was comfortable and family-friendly, which made it easy for the kids to enjoy without feeling rushed or tired. From airport transfers and hotels to sightseeing and meals, everything was perfectly organized.

Our tour leader and local guides were incredibly supportive, patient, and caring, especially with the children. They made sure everyone felt comfortable and included, which we truly appreciated. The accommodations were excellent, the food options were great for both adults and kids, and the entire experience felt safe and well-managed.

Vietnam is a beautiful country, and thanks to Glamour Tours, we could focus on making memories instead of worrying about arrangements. We came back with amazing experiences.
I would highly recommend Glamour Tours to families looking for a hassle-free and enjoyable vacation especially with kids. We would definitely love to travel with them again!
